commands.command:
set -e
EXPECTED_SHA="15931fa8341784a308f8a8b9ea6ebd68279241fc"
git fetch origin main --quiet
git checkout --detach "$EXPECTED_SHA" >/dev/null 2>&1
APK="$(find app/build/outputs/apk/debug -name '*.apk' -type f | head -n1)"
test -n "$APK"

adb kill-server >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
adb start-server >/dev/null

python3 - <<'PY'
import subprocess,re,sys,time

def run(args,timeout=8):
    try:
        return subprocess.run(args,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=timeout)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        return None

def find_s22():
    p=run(["adb","devices"],4)
    if not p: return None
    for line in p.stdout.splitlines()[1:]:
        parts=line.split()
        if len(parts)>=2 and parts[1]=="device":
            serial=parts[0]
            q=run(["adb","-s",serial,"shell","getprop","ro.product.model"],4)
            if q and q.stdout.strip()=="SM-S906B":
                return serial
    return None

for attempt in range(8):
    serial=find_s22()
    if serial:
        open("/tmp/tracker-s22-serial","w").write(serial)
        print(f"S22_REDISCOVERED attempt={attempt+1}")
        sys.exit(0)

    mdns=run(["adb","mdns","services"],8)
    endpoints=[]
    if mdns:
        print("MDNS_SCAN", attempt+1)
        for line in mdns.stdout.splitlines():
            if "_adb-tls-connect._tcp" in line:
                for token in reversed(line.split()):
                    if re.search(r":\d+$",token):
                        endpoints.append(token)
                        break
    for ep in endpoints:
        run(["adb","connect",ep],5)
        time.sleep(.5)
        serial=find_s22()
        if serial:
            open("/tmp/tracker-s22-serial","w").write(serial)
            print(f"S22_REDISCOVERED attempt={attempt+1}")
            sys.exit(0)
    time.sleep(5)

print("S22_NOT_DISCOVERABLE_AFTER_RETRIES")
sys.exit(42)
PY

S="$(cat /tmp/tracker-s22-serial)"
OUT="$(adb -s "$S" install --no-streaming -r "$APK" 2>&1)"
printf '%s\n' "$OUT"
test -n "$(adb -s "$S" shell pm path io.blueeye | tr -d '' | head -n1)"
adb -s "$S" shell monkey -p io.blueeye -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER 1 >/dev/null
sleep 1
PID="$(adb -s "$S" shell pidof io.blueeye | tr -d '' | head -n1)"
test -n "$PID"
printf 'FINAL_INSTALL_OK sha=%s model=SM-S906B package=io.blueeye data_preserved=yes app_running=yes pid=%s\n' "$EXPECTED_SHA" "$PID"
